protocol.description: Activates on "water"/"Water" across lists, ingredients, and environmental descriptions, and on tokens at the boundary before eleven-related continuations. The second pattern includes contexts eliciting 11/eleven, November as the eleventh month, K as the eleventh English letter, or XI as the eleventh positive integer. Activation may occur on a preceding word, separator, or assistant-prefix token rather than the number itself; it is wording-dependent and sometimes appears for neighboring ordinals.

protocol.scope: Self-authored input-token probes derived from the frozen description; no judge and no generation.
design_notes: The tool accepts texts, not an explanation. The description is frozen metadata used to design probes.
Preserve zero gates, exact token IDs, added/control tokens, and every input position.
Use the unmodified upstream MCP verify_hypothesis registration and backing method.
A self-authored-only session bypasses corpus initialization without fabricating corpus examples.
The original SteeringEngine and MoltGates run native Qwen3; derived gate-only checkpoint contains exact encoder tensors.
Compute the original dashboard BF16-autocast gate; FP32 gate values are an additional precision diagnostic.
Neighboring ordinals are probes of specificity, not pre-labelled negatives; the revised description already allows wording dependence.
No score of description quality is inferred from these hand-authored probes.
